# Lab 8.6: Connect Dataform to GitHub

## What We Are Going to Do
Connect the Dataform repository to a GitHub repository, then commit, push and pull your work.

## Steps

1. **Create a GitHub repository.** Create an empty private repo, for example `bq-course-dataform`. Create a **fine-grained personal access token** with **Contents: Read and write** on that repo.

2. **[CLI] Store the token in Secret Manager.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable secretmanager.googleapis.com
printf "YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN" | gcloud secrets create dataform-github-token --data-file=-
PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")
gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding dataform-github-token \
  --member=serviceAccount:service-$PROJECT_NUMBER@gcp-sa-dataform.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Connect the repository.** Open the Dataform repository → **Settings → Connect with Git**:
   - **Remote URL**: `https://github.com/YOUR_USER/bq-course-dataform.git`
   - **Default branch**: `main`
   - **Secret**: `dataform-github-token`

4. **[Console] Commit and push.** In your workspace click **Commit changes**, write a message like `Add staging and marts`, then **Push to default branch**. Check GitHub: the files are there.

5. **[Console] Pull a change.** Edit a description on GitHub and commit it. In the workspace click **Pull from default branch**.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Remote | Dataform linked to GitHub |
| Token | Stored in Secret Manager, not in code |
| Commit / push | Workspace changes reach GitHub |
| Pull | GitHub changes reach the workspace |
